name: internet-screen-share
description: Internet screen sharing with Electron, WebRTC and public signaling

scripts.dev: set PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:8080&& npm run build && concurrently -k "tsx server/src/index.ts" "electron ."
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:server && npm run build:electron && npm run build:web
scripts.build:web: esbuild web/src/viewer.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outfile=dist/web/viewer.js && copyfiles -u 2 web/public/* dist/web && copyfiles -u 1 electron/host.html electron/host.css dist/electron
